title: 12 Best Mexico City Brunch Culture Spots
description: Explore Mexico City's vibrant brunch scene. Discover 12 top spots for traditional chilaquiles, trendy avocado toast, or gourmet pastries. Find your perfect morning meal in CDMX!

places.name: El Cardenal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Huevos Rancheros or the Omelette de Escamoles (ant larvae, if you're adventurous) served with fresh 'pan dulce' and hot chocolate.

places.name: Rosetta
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their freshly baked pastries (especially the guava roll), the 'huevos pochados' with hoja santa, or the fresh pasta.

places.name: Lardo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Huevos Rancheros' with crispy tortillas, the 'Shakshuka', or any of their seasonal vegetable dishes.

places.name: Niddo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chilaquiles with Short Rib' or the 'Ricotta Pancakes' are crowd-pleasers. Don't forget a fresh juice.

places.name: Ojo de Agua
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their giant fruit bowls, the 'Machaca con Huevo', or a custom-made juice blend.

places.name: Fónico
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Molletes con Chorizo' or their seasonal 'Enchiladas'. Pair with a unique cocktail or fresh agua fresca.

places.name: Delirio
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Huevos al Horno', any of their quiches, or a fresh sandwich made with their artisanal bread.

places.name: Eno
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Molletes', 'Chilaquiles Rojos', or a simple 'Avocado Toast' with a Mexican twist.

places.name: Marmota
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their unique 'Breakfast Burrito' or the 'French Toast' with creative toppings. Don't skip their coffee.

places.name: Balcón del Zócalo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their 'Enfrijoladas' or 'Huevos Divorciados', enjoyed with a mimosa and the stunning panoramic view.

places.name: Sanborns Casa de los Azulejos
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Enchiladas Suizas' (a Sanborns classic) or any of their breakfast platters with a traditional café de olla.

places.name: Chilaquil
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chilaquiles with cochinita pibil and a fried egg on top.
